Rows delete themselves after 14 days and are kept out of memory writes. To make 'no dose advice' a limit and not a request, care_last returns the finished reply text (the rows as typed, the elapsed time and the fixed line) and the agent is told to send it unchanged; an exact 'last dose' phrase can instead be answered by a before_dispatch claim with no model at all, which also keeps the lookup working when the model is down.
